snippet.title: Star Fox – Battle Mode Free Update – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
A new update to Battle Mode is coming to Star Fox on September 29, 2026. Learn more: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/star-fox-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Join the fray with up to four players locally in Battle Mode with three new stages! Gain control of the platforms on Katina, destroy asteroids in Sector X, and scan data modules in Venom. 

Plus, form a team with up to four players and join online battles on a single Nintendo Switch 2. 

#NintendoDirect #StarFox 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
